from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/seen/play/users/u038/system/state/workspace/programs/task-4e3e1b1d.py')
s='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Fill the interior of the rectangular loop with the marker color.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Locate matching rectangular contours: all four edges share the non-background color.
    colors = set(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = max(colors, key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in grid))
    for color in colors - {bg}:
        pts = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        if not pts: continue
        r0,r1=min(r for r,c in pts),max(r for r,c in pts)
        c0,c1=min(c for r,c in pts),max(c for r,c in pts)
        # A closed box can be recognized when its four sides are present.
        if all(grid[r0][c] == color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and all(grid[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and all(grid[r][c0] == color and grid[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0,r1+1)):
            for r in range(r0+1,r1):
                for c in range(c0+1,c1):
                    if grid[r][c] == bg: out[r][c] = 4
    return out
'''
p.write_text(s)
